title: fix(providers): map Anthropic model_context_window_exceeded to length

files.patch:
@@ -240,7 +240,7 @@ func (p *AnthropicProvider) parseResponse(resp *anthropicResponse) *ChatResponse
 	switch resp.StopReason {
 	case "tool_use":
 		result.FinishReason = "tool_calls"
-	case "max_tokens":
+	case "max_tokens", "model_context_window_exceeded":
 		result.FinishReason = "length"
 	default:
 		result.FinishReason = "stop"

@@ -135,7 +135,7 @@ func (p *AnthropicProvider) ChatStream(ctx context.Context, req ChatRequest, onC
 					switch ev.Delta.StopReason {
 					case "tool_use":
 						result.FinishReason = "tool_calls"
-					case "max_tokens":
+					case "max_tokens", "model_context_window_exceeded":
 						result.FinishReason = "length"
 					default:
 						result.FinishReason = "stop"
